h1: Short video edits for Reels, TikTok and Shorts
overview: Send us your raw clips and we turn them into short vertical videos that hold attention. We cut out the slow parts, set the pacing, add readable captions, music or sound from licensed libraries, and finish with a clear end line. Each video is exported in the right size for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. We keep your voice and style, and you can ask for changes within your revisions.

faq: Do I have to film everything myself?
Yes. We edit footage you send, from a phone or camera. We can suggest shots to capture before you film, and we can use licensed stock clips if you need filler.
How do I send large video files?
Through a shared drive link, such as Google Drive or Dropbox. We tell you the best formats after you order, and we keep your footage private and delete it after delivery if you ask.
We use music from licensed libraries available to business accounts, and tell you the source. Trending sounds are best added inside the app when you post, so we leave that choice to you.
Can you write the script or ideas?
The editing price covers cutting your footage. Ideas and scripts come from the content plan or creative brief services, which you can add.
